scripts.fix: npm run format && npm run lint:fix
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run check:no-js-source && npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit
scripts.verify: npm run fix && npm run check
scripts.deploy: npm run build:frontend && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy
scripts.docs:api: npx --yes --package typedoc@0.28.20 --package typedoc-plugin-markdown@4.12.0 --package typescript@6.0.2 typedoc && tsx scripts/docs/publish-api-docs.ts
scripts.docs:architecture:check: npx --yes --package typescript@6.0.2 --package dependency-cruiser@18.1.0 depcruise src frontend --config .dependency-cruiser.json --ts-config tsconfig.json --output-type err
scripts.docs:architecture: tsx scripts/ensure-directories.ts docs/public/generated && npx --yes --package typescript@6.0.2 --package dependency-cruiser@18.1.0 depcruise src frontend --config .dependency-cruiser.json --ts-config tsconfig.json --output-type html --output-to docs/public/generated/dependencies.html
scripts.docs:generate: npm run docs:api && npm run docs:architecture && npm run docs:db
scripts.docs:build: npm run docs:generate && npx vitepress build docs
scripts.docs:dev: npm run docs:generate && npx vitepress dev docs
scripts.types:worker: tsx scripts/ensure-directories.ts .generated && tsx scripts/run-quiet.ts wrangler types .generated/worker-configuration.d.ts
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:worker && npm run build:admin-worker && npm run build:lambda
scripts.build:frontend: npm run build:frontend:public && npm run build:frontend:admin
